title: VTG Playboy April 1989 with Centerfold— NCAA College Girls Of The Big East
descriptionText: The product is a vintage issue of Playboy magazine from April 1989, featuring a centerfold on NCAA College Girls Of The Big East. This magazine includes a variety of content across genres such as cars, women, fashion, history, business, technology, and more. With contributions from celebrities and public figures like Gypsy Rose, Taylor Swift, Donald Trump, and Kim Kardashian, this issue covers topics in music, politics, sports, and beyond. This particular edition offers a glimpse into the popular culture and lifestyle of the 1980s and 1990s, making it a collectible item for fans of classic Playboy magazines.
